system.description: • Effect: As your action, study one creature you can see; from the start of your next turn it is your Studied target until the end of the encounter. You may study before a fight. A Death Attack needs two rounds of study at 1st level, and one from 7th.

activities.name: Study
activities.text: As your action, study one creature you can see; from the start of your next turn it is your Studied target until the end of the encounter (you may study before a fight). A Death Attack needs {1:two rounds, 7:one round} of study. Target it and apply Studied: your attack cards then list it for Sneak Attack.
